an7.64:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattime bhikkhave, dhammā sapattakantā sapattakaraṇā kodhanaṃ āgacchanti itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
an7.64:1.3: idha bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati:
an7.64:1.6: na bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa vaṇṇavatāya nandati.
an7.64:1.7: kodhanoyaṃ bhikkhave purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto. kiñcāpi so hoti sunahāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu odātavatthavasano,
an7.64:1.8: atha kho so dubbaṇṇova hoti kodhābhibhūto.
an7.64:1.9: ayaṃ bhikkhave, paṭhamo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. (2)
an7.64:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati:
an7.64:2.4: na bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa sukhaseyyāya nandati.
an7.64:2.5: kodhanoyaṃ bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto. kiñcāpi so pallaṅke seti goṇakatthate paṭikatthate paṭalikatthate kādalimigapavarapaccattharaṇe sauttaracchade ubhato lohitakūpadhāne,
an7.64:2.6: atha kho so dukkhaṃyeva seti kodhābhibhūto.
an7.64:2.7: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. (3)
an7.64:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati:
an7.64:3.4: na bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa pacuratthatāya nandati.
an7.64:3.5: kodhanoyaṃ bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto. anatthampi gahetvā attho me gahitoti maññati. atthampi gahetvā anattho me gahitoti maññati.
an7.64:3.6: tassime dhammā aññamaññaṃ vipaccanīkā gahitā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti kodhābhibhūtassa.
an7.64:3.7: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. (4)
an7.64:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati:
an7.64:4.4: na bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa bhogavatāya nandati.
an7.64:4.5: kodhanassa bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa kodhābhibhūtassa kodhaparetassa yepissa te honti bhogā uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sedāvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā, tepirājāno rājakosaṃ pavesenti kodhābhibhūtassa.
an7.64:4.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave, catuttho dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. (5)
an7.64:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati:
an7.64:5.4: na bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa yasavatāya nandati.
an7.64:5.5: kodhanoyaṃ bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto. yopissa so hoti yaso appamādādhigato tamhāpi dhaṃsati kodhābhibhūto.
an7.64:5.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave, pañcamo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. (6)
an7.64:6.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati:
an7.64:6.4: na bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa mittavatāya nandati.
an7.64:6.5: kodhanoyaṃ bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto. yepissa te honti mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā, tepi ārakā taṃ parivajjentī kodhābhibhūtaṃ.
an7.64:6.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave, chaṭṭho dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā. (7)
an7.64:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati:
an7.64:7.2: aho vatāyaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyāti.
an7.64:7.4: na bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa sugatigamanena nandati.
an7.64:7.5: kodhanoyaṃ bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an7.64:7.7: kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati. kodhābhi bhūto.
an7.64:7.8: ayaṃ bhikkhave, sattamo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
an7.64:8.1: ime kho bhikkhave, satta dhammā sapattakantā sapattakaraṇā kodhanaṃ āgacchanti itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vāti.
